estimates.assumptions: 2 tbsp vegetable oil = 28 g; pure oil, zero carbs
400 g raw beef strips (lean sirloin-type cut assumed); meat has zero carbs

handful fresh basil leaves ≈ 15 g; standard fresh basil values
